results.content: Intelligent fitness systems with wireless sensors and optical measurement technology can monitor heart rate, breathing rate, and exercise intensity in real time for more accurate health feedback [[5](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#B5-eng-06-00115),[6](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#B6-eng-06-00115)]. In [Figure 2](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#fig_body_display_eng-06-00115-f002), a smart device holder is provided at the handrail, which is convenient for users to place a tablet computer or mobile phone; meanwhile, the monitoring devices on both sides of the handrail are able to monitor data such as heart rate and energy consumption in real time, and the exercise bike module mainly provides aerobic exercise. In order to better guide different groups to adapt their health conditions to exercise, we use fitness equipment with monitoring functions, as shown in [Table 10](https://www.mdpi.com/2673-4117/6/6/115#table_body_display_eng-06-00115-t010), to guide people of different age groups to choose the appropriate exercise methods, and at the same time, provide feedback on the physical health status of different people. [](mailto:?&subject=From%20MDPI%3A%20%22Research%20on%20Functional%20Modularity%20and%20Health%20Monitoring%20Design%20of%20Home%20Fitness%20Equipment%22&body=https://www.mdpi.com/3333240%3A%0A%0AResearch%20on%20Functional%20Modularity%20and%20Health%20Monitoring%20Design%20of%20Home%20Fitness%20Equipment%0A%0AAbstract%3A%20Under%20the%20%26ldquo%3BHealthy%20China%26rdquo%3B%20strategy%2C%20the%20demand%20for%20home%20fitness%20equipment%20is%20increasing%2C%20but%20existing%20solutions%20face%20challenges%20such%20as%20large%20size%2C%20limited%20functionality%2C%20and%20lack%20of%20personalization.%20This%20study%20proposes%20an%20innovative%20integrated%20design%20framework%20for%20multifunctional%20home%20fitness%20equipment%2C%20combining%20modular%20design%2C%20space%20optimization%2C%20and%20intelligent%20health%20monitoring.%20The%20design%20integrates%20an%20exercise%20bike%2C%20rowing%20machine%2C%20and%20spring%20tensioner%20into%20a%20single%20unit%2C%20reducing%20equipment%20footprint%20by%2030%25%20while%20enabling%20seamless%20transitions%20between%20exercise%20modes.%20Multimodal%20sensors%20collect%20real-time%20physiological%20data%2C%20processed%20via%20Kalman%20filtering%20and%20adaptive%20algorithms%20to%20generate%20personalized%20fitness%20recommendations.%20The%20system%20achieves%2095%25%20monitoring%20accuracy%20for%20key%20metrics%20%28heart%20rate%3A%2097%26ndash%3B147%20bpm%2C%20energy%20consumption%3A%20216%26ndash%3B550%20kcal%29%20and%20improves%20user%20satisfaction%20by%2040%25%20compared%20to%20conventional%20equipment.%20This%20research%20demonstrates%20a%20scalable%20and%20intelligent%20solution%20that%20bridges%20the%20gap%20between%20multifunctional%20integration%20and%20user-centric%20health%20management%2C%20offering%20significant%20advancements%20over%20previous%20designs. results.title: Frontiers | Modular architecture confers robustness to damage and facilitates recovery in spiking neural networks modeling in vitro neurons
results.content: # Modular architecture confers robustness to damage and facilitates recovery in spiking neural networks modeling *in vitro* neurons. In this work, we numerically modeled the response and recovery to damage of a neuronal network *in vitro* bearing a modular structure. The model supports that the combination of modularity and plasticity confers robustness to the damaged neuronal network by preventing the total loss of spontaneous network-wide activity and facilitating recovery. Additionally, by using our model within the reservoir computing framework, we show that information representation in the neuronal network improves with the recovery of network-wide activity. Restoration of neuronal activity is central to the recovery of brain function, a process that has been extensively investigated *in vivo* (Fukui et al., 2020) and *in vitro* (Ayasreh et al., 2022; Teller et al., 2020). In this study, we conducted experiments on cultured neurons and a spiking neural network (SNN) model, both of which were designed with a modular organization, to examine their response to damage.
